# Production dependencies, pinned and hashed.
#
# Every install is offline and hash-verified:
#   ops/vendor.sh           downloads these wheels while the internet is available
#   ops/offline_install.sh  rebuilds the venv from vendor/wheels with no network
#
# Hashes cover every distribution file of each pinned version, so the same pins verify
# on the Linux VPS and on a developer machine. Regenerate after any version change.
#
# No telemetry, error-reporting or cloud SDK appears here, by design.
#
# `uvicorn` serves the process; `uvloop`, `httptools` and `websockets` are the loop,
# HTTP and WebSocket implementations `ops/systemd/chat.service` names on its command
# line, so each is a hard runtime dependency rather than an optional accelerator.
